pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

3. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

4. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

5. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

6. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.

7. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library?

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. run

10. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

11. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goes
   C. went
   D. goed

12. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language Activities at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

2. A — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

4. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.

6. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.

7. D — Where is the library?

8. D — A person, place, thing, or idea

9. D — run

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

11. C — went

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Word Reading; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Connected text and fluency; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language Activities at home; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Comprehension; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
